_wave51_correction: WAVE 51 (2026-09-15) — THIS RECORD'S CONCLUSION IS WRONG. The cause IS runtime code: retro R2's PercentSizeClamp (runtimes/compose/src/main/java/com/styleconverter/runtime/sizing/PercentSizeClamp.kt) is a Modifier.layout {} block, and Compose answers an INTRINSIC query for such a block with the child's raw intrinsic (MeasuringIntrinsics / DefaultIntrinsicMeasurable ignores the minHeight the block passes), so TableApplier's heightAtMinIntrinsic row query saw 0 where the pre-R2 heightIn(min = 100) SizeNode answered 100; -005 survives because its 100px content child IS the intrinsic. Re-run on device with the installed base.apk sha1 VERIFIED against the build (one -read-only emulator, the provision flags, feed-android.mjs --composed over the five carriers): CONTROL (tree 8864f33c, APK sha1 984c4a69…) -003/-004/-006 PNG sha1 19cda0efe724 = the wave50-final and wave51-open red capture, -005 8c0056dd8884, -007 e184684d71ce; FIX (the min/max SizeNode chained INSIDE the clamp, APK sha1 fe4ec50a…) -003/-004/-006 PNG sha1 8c0056dd8884 = the wave-49 GREEN capture byte-for-byte, -005/-007 unchanged; fidelity pairs-01 PW_Background_Sizing_04 still 300x80 on Android (the R2 gain kept). The four wave-50 A/B runs below recorded SCORES ONLY — no APK sha1, no install evidence — and A/B 1 (lane disabled) and A/B 4 (wave-49 runtime) contradict the code reading above, so their rebuilt APKs most likely never reached the device. Lesson, now a BACKLOG standing constraint: a device A/B that claims to EXCLUDE a code change records the installed base.apk sha1 against the build it claims to test.
